integrity: Exact algebraic argument and standalone exhaustive rational-arithmetic checks for selected small Latin squares; no independent certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives mean and variance for uniform isotopy relabellings, not the full distribution; the zero-variance group-table classification is a corollary using a known extremal intercalate theorem. Historical priority and independent verification remain open.
title: Intercalates determine the full-isotopy total-ascent variance of a Latin square
